source: Utopia first-fruit pressure test plus immediate Flower-on-Flower self-recursion
thesis: The prior methodology could optimize local sophistication, autonomy, and a selected branch while underweighting terminal value, opportunity cost, reachable distribution, branch replacement, and the value of acting instead of recursively improving the method.
mutations: distribution and fulfillment before heavy construction

observedExperiment.failureSignal: Internal and infrastructure progress materially outpaced external economic conversion, showing proxy drift and branch lock-in despite recursive improvement.

newFailureRisksDetected: hard-coding first-dollar speed could itself become a proxy
unbounded recursion could turn methodology improvement into avoidance
immediate evidence could extinguish longer-horizon discovery
added methodology laws could create more mandatory complexity than decision capability

assessment.why: The mutations directly address observed allocation failures while preserving existing evidence, sovereignty, fixed-point, provenance, and complexity-preserving-efficiency guarantees.
assessment.rollback: Revert integrated-v3 control-plane commits and restore integrated-v2 if regression tests or later accountable evidence show lower decision quality or harmful search churn.
assessment.falsifier: If integrated-v3 repeatedly increases search churn, delays strong known boundaries without producing materially better challengers, or reduces terminal conversion relative to integrated-v2 under comparable evidence, the promotion should be reconsidered.
